title: Accounts Receivable - French speaking

title: Administrator
description:
Administrator
Location: Fareham / Gosport
Salary: £26,000 per annum
Contract: Temporary ongoing, with a view to permanent
Hours: Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week
shifts between 7.30 and 3,30 and 9- 5 (one week of 7.30 - 3.30 followed by 2 weeks of 9-5 )
The Opportunity Dynamite Recruitment is delighted to be working in partnership with an independent, well-established business based in the Fareham / Gosport area.
Due to continued growth and increasing workloads, our client is looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Administrator to join their friendly and supportive team.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a busy, established business on a temporary ongoing basis, with the potential to secure a permanent position for the right person.
What's on Offer?
- £26,000 annual salary.
- Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week.
- Temporary ongoing opportunity with a view to permanent employment.
- Friendly and supportive working environment.
- Opportunity to develop and grow within an established business.
- Quarterly performance-related bonus available upon becoming permanent, based on company profitability.

The Role As an Administrator, you will play an important role in supporting a specialist operational team, ensuring the smooth running of day-to-day administration, customer requests and service coordination.
Your responsibilities will include
- Supporting key clients with their requirements and managing client contracts.
- Processing work orders and maintaining accurate internal records.
- Raising requests for equipment installations and maintenance.
- Raising quotes
- Working closely with supervisors to manage maintenance contracts and ensure equipment is serviced on schedule.
- Liaising with field operatives to coordinate workloads, plan routes and manage diaries.

About You We're looking for someone who is organised, proactive and takes pride in delivering a great service.

Interested? If you're looking for your next opportunity and would love to join a friendly, busy and established business offering the potential for long-term career prospects, we'd love to hear from you!
Apply today by submitting your CV to Dynamite Recruitment.

title: Business Support Coordinator
description:
Business Support Coordinator

Location: Fareham Area
Salary: 32,000 - 35,000 per annum
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Working Pattern: Monday to Friday 8:00 - 5:00pm. Fully Office-Based

About the Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Business Support Coordinator to join a well-established and growing business in the Fareham area.

Working within a small, friendly team, you'll provide essential support across administration, compliance, finance, customer service and office operations. This is a varied role where no two days are the same, requiring a flexible approach and a willingness to get stuck in wherever needed.

This position offers excellent long-term career prospects and the opportunity to develop your skills within a supportive business environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide administrative support across the business.
- Assist with compliance and health & safety documentation.
- Process invoices and maintain accurate records.
- Manage filing, document control and archiving.
- Support stock and inventory administration.
- Handle customer enquiries via telephone and email.
- Coordinate office supplies and general office administration.
- Support meetings, training activities, events and exhibitions.
- Undertake reception and front-of-house duties.
- Provide ad-hoc support to the wider team as required.

About You
- Previous experience in an administration, coordination or business support role.
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- Proactive, self-motivated and adaptable.
- Comfortable working independently and as part of a small team.
- Happy to take ownership of tasks and support across different business areas.

Skills & Requirements
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint and Teams.
- Full UK driving licence desirable.
- Occasional UK travel may be required.
- Successful applicants will be required to complete a DBS check.
- Ability to obtain additional background screening if required.

What's on Offer?
- 32,000 - 35,000 salary.
- Full-time permanent position.
- Fully office-based role.
- Supportive team environment.
- Varied and interesting workload.
- Training and development opportunities.
- Genuine opportunities for career progression.

Please Note: Our client is looking to interview immediately but the anticipated start date is mid- January 2027.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator or coordinator seeking a varied role within a growing organisation where they can make a real impact and build a long-term career.

title: Internal Sales Coordinator

description:

- Strong organisational abilities with a keen eye for detail and the capacity to multitask in a fast-paced setting.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience with CRM systems (experience with Microsoft Dynamics is advantageous).

What You Will Get
We provide a competitive basic salary alongside a rewarding incentive scheme designed to recognise and incentivise success. Our flexible benefits package includes:
- 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 with service) plus all public/bank holidays
- Additional holiday purchase scheme
- Contributory pension scheme

- Annual paid volunteering day
- Simply Health/Dental plan options
- Enhanced HR policies and long service awards
- Charitable giving options
- Financial support with eye tests and glasses (DSE users)
- EE mobile discount scheme

Shape Your Future with Us
At Macfarlane Group, your potential is limitless. We empower our people with structured career pathways and continuous training, so whether you re expanding your skills in sales support or aspiring to new challenges, your future is bright with us.

Ready to Take Your Sales Career to the Next Level

We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds irrespective of your age, gender, disability, race, nationality, ethnicity, gender identity, religion, or sexual orientation. title: Media Capability Manager
description:
Our client is seeking a Media Capability Manager to provide functional leadership across media and courseware development within the defence and security sector. Based in Fareham, Hampshire, with hybrid working and travel to other Ministry of Defence sites, this permanent role will lead governance, standardisation, quality assurance and continuous improvement across a geographically distributed media capability.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the media capability across multiple sites, ensuring consistency across media and courseware outputs, processes, standards and quality assurance activities
- Own and maintain the enterprise media governance framework, including procedures, templates, quality documentation and technical standards
- Oversee the specification, design, development and deployment of training media and courseware solutions
- Ensure media activities align with Defence Systems Approach to Training (DSAT), the Media Quality Management System (QMS), contractual requirements and relevant Defence policies
- Provide governance and assurance throughout the media delivery lifecycle, ensuring outputs are compliant, accessible, learner-centred and fit for purpose
- Oversee media infrastructure and enabling services, including repositories, Media LAN services, content management approaches, Learning Management Systems (LMS), Virtual Learning Environments (VLE) and Defence Information Systems
- Lead technical media input into customer change requests and transformation initiatives, coordinating suitably qualified and experienced personnel to support solution development
- Monitor quality metrics, risks, lessons identified and assurance activity, providing updates to programme leadership and driving continuous improvement

Job Requirements:
- Leadership experience within a learning, media, courseware development or instructional design environment
- Strong knowledge of media development processes, governance, standardisation and quality assurance
- Practical understanding of UK Ministry of Defence procedures and policies, DSAT or the ADDIE model
- Experience improving processes, procedures and operational ways of working across distributed or matrix teams
- Knowledge of training design methodologies, media design principles and traditional and modern training methods
- Experience with digital media tools, including Adobe Creative Cloud, 2 D or 3 D design applications, Blender, Unity and Articulate 360
- Understanding of motion graphics, video content creation, illustration development and marketing principles relevant to digital learning content
- Excellent communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, planning, prioritisation and problem-solving skills

Experience with programme management tools, multi-site delivery environments, blended learning, digital learning technologies and Royal Navy, Defence or further education training environments would be advantageous. A relevant qualification in leadership and management, learning and development, digital media or graphic design would also be beneficial.

Benefits:
- Contributory pension scheme
- Life assurance linked to the pension scheme
- Annual leave entitlement that increases with service, plus the option to buy and sell additional days
- Flexible benefits scheme, including health cash plan, dental cover and Cycle to Work options
- Enhanced sick pay and family-friendly policies
- Hybrid, remote and site-based working opportunities, subject to role requirements
- Early finish on Fridays and a flexible working culture focused on outcomes
- Up to five paid volunteering days each year

If you are an experienced Media Capability Manager with a background in marketing, digital learning, courseware development or Defence training, this is an excellent opportunity to contribute to innovative training transformation across the UK defence and security environment. Apply now.
